content: pushing in with the allen key worked great. 2x5... there are only 4 holes per FS-top... should be 2x4 but nice to have the extra sleeves.
I used the short end of the 2,0 mm Allen key to push it into place once I could see it from the bottom.
Watch that the sleeves slide in oriented correctly. There's room for them to flip over sideways. Use a magnifying glass to check before you try to push/snap them in place.
See my note on step 49.  Add the sleeves after installing the board.

replies.content:
If you follow the instructions, the sleeves will fit properly, no need to potentially make scratches to the board with a tool (i.e. breaking it).

I just pushed the sleeves in and helped with small screwdriver to align with the holes.
